name: Mononobe Rikiya
source: Teaching tips on how to be a good test-taker, he has guided many of his students to pass their entrance exams. He's popular for being easy to talk to and his relaxed demeanor. He likes teasing Mr. Taishi. He is a little rough around the edges, and a little scary. But, the kindness in his eyes and touch is warmer than anyone else's... When you're in his arms, will he do whatever it takes to make you happy?
